jobs.title: Singapore Marine Structural Fitter & Fabricator
jobs.experience: 3+ Years in Hull Structure & Marine Fabrication
jobs.description: Urgent recruitment for experienced Marine Structural Fitters to support offshore vessel retrofit, pipe rack installation, and structural steel assembly in Jurong shipyard.
responsibilities: Read structural engineering drawings, isometric blueprints, and welding symbols
Cut, bevel, align, and tack-weld structural steel plates and beams
Collaborate with 6G welders and shipyard safety officers
requirements: Valid Indian passport with minimum 2 years validity
Prior experience in shipyard, offshore, or heavy industrial fabrication
Fit for physical shipyard work in Singapore climate
benefits: Guaranteed overtime (1.5x on normal days, 2.0x on public holidays)
Full medical and personal accident insurance under MOM
requiredDocuments: ITI Fitter certificate and past experience letters
Clear passport-size photograph on white background

jobs.title: CNC Milling & Turning Machinist
jobs.description: Direct recruitment for precision aerospace and oil & gas machining facility in Jurong. Operating 3-axis and 5-axis CNC Milling / Turning centers with Fanuc / Siemens controls.
responsibilities: Set up and operate CNC Milling and CNC Lathe machines independently
Interpret engineering drawings and technical GD&T specifications
Perform tool preset, fixture alignment, and basic G-code / M-code editing
Conduct in-process dimensional inspection using micrometers, vernier calipers, and bore gauges
requirements: Valid Indian Passport with at least 18 months validity
Minimum 2 years proven hands-on CNC machining experience
Ability to understand workshop technical drawings and basic English
benefits: Overtime allowance (1.5x on weekdays, 2.0x on Sundays/PH)
Comprehensive medical and hospitalization insurance coverage under MOM regulations
Annual leave, medical leave, and performance bonus
requiredDocuments: Updated Resume / Bio-data with detailed machine models
Trade experience certificates and work sample photos/videos

jobs.title: 6G Pipe Welder (TIG & ARC)
jobs.experience: 3+ Years in High Pressure Piping or Marine Shipyard
jobs.description: Urgent requirement for certified 6G Pipe Welders for offshore vessel maintenance and pressure piping fabrication in Tuas Shipyard.
responsibilities: Perform GTAW (TIG) root pass and SMAW (ARC) capping on carbon and stainless steel pipes in 6G position
Pass 100% visual and X-ray / Radiographic Testing (RT) weld criteria
Comply strictly with Singapore shipyard safety, permit-to-work (PTW), and confined space protocols
requirements: Valid Indian Passport with 2+ years validity
Valid or previous 6G Welding Performance Qualification record (WQR)
Gulf or Singapore shipyard experience preferred
benefits: Shipyard safety boots, helmets, and protective gear provided
Approved dormitory accommodation with Indian food catering option
MOM standard medical and hospitalization insurance
requiredDocuments: 6G Welder qualification certificates and past weld logbooks
Short 1-2 minute video of TIG welding root & face

jobs.title: Heavy Reach Truck & Forklift Operator
jobs.description: Operating reach trucks and counterbalance forklifts in temperature-controlled FMCG distribution warehouse in Changi South.
responsibilities: Safe operation of high-reach trucks up to 10-meter bay racking
Loading, unloading containerized cargo, and pallet put-away
Scan barcodes and perform stock movement verification using RF guns
requirements: Valid driving license / heavy vehicle experience
Physical fitness to work in warehouse shift environment
Clear police verification and valid Indian passport
benefits: Company transport pick-up points across major dormitories
requiredDocuments: Driving license and heavy equipment experience letters
